'''Hurst Romodi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Matacorn]], he served with distinction in [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector's]] [[Planetary Security Forces]] before becoming one of the Galactic Republic's first non-[[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

After the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|defeat]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the Galactic Empire, Romodi was appointed a general in the Imperial [[Army/Legends|Army]]. He led Imperial [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground forces]] against [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] in the [[Ciutric Offensive]] of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], winning several major victories and becoming a celebrated figure in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. During the latter campaign, Romodi's forces were [[Ambush at Bryndar|ambushed]] by [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]] at [[Bryndar]]; Romodi won the day, but was left blind and deeply scarred. Romodi left [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] service to become the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the Lambda [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. However, he suffered recurring [[Dream/Legends|nightmares]] and an inability to concentrate as a result of his injuries, and retired after a single term in office.

Romodi was offered the opportunity to continue working as [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]] to [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and served under Tarkin as [[Battle Station Operations/Legends|Battle Station Operations]] [[Chief/Legends|chief]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of its [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Biography==
===Service to the Republic===
The [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="ANHn" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ANH" /> Hurst Romodi was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Matacorn]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Lambda [[Sector/Legends|sector]] had a long history of conflict involving the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and, during Romodi's lifetime, the sector was embroiled in a [[Andoan Wars/Legends|war]] between [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]<ref name="EGTW" />&mdash;the Aqualish [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="Ando">{{CSWECite|I|30|Ando}}</ref>&mdash;and the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]]. Serving in the sector's [[Planetary Security Forces]], Romodi made a name for<ref name="EGTW" /> himself<ref name="ANHn" /> fighting Aqualish rebels around this [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="EGTW" /> In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]]<ref name="23BBY">{{YearMathGRS}}</ref> the sector was further divided, with Ando among those worlds seceding from the Republic during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}}</ref> Romodi, however, remained loyal to the Republic and, after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Romodi joined the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. One of the first non-[[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to command [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the Clone Wars, Romodi rose to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] and was decorated for his role in battles at [[Peldon Minor]], [[Tulatharri Junction]] and [[Battle of Mygeeto|Mygeeto]].<ref name="EGTW" />

===Imperial Army===
[[File:Hurst_Romodi.jpg|thumb|left|220px|General Romodi leading from the open hatch of a Floating Fortress]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|conclusion]] of the Clone Wars and the subsequent [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganization]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Romodi was commissioned as a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. With the Confederacy of Independent Systems defeated, [[Confederacy military/Legends|Separatist forces]] from [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] fled to the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]] and the surrounding region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where they joined forces with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]]. As part of a [[Reconquest of the Rim|series of offensives]] aimed at bringing order to the far reaches of the Empire, [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] launched a [[Ciutric Offensive|campaign]] to eliminate the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]], for which Romodi was assigned to [[Tenth Army|Crimson Dagger Command]], based out of [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]], and given command of the [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground forces]]. The Ciutric Offensive saw Romodi work closely with [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]], defeating Separatist forces in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz]], [[Tragan Cluster/Legends|Tragan]], Ciutric, [[Nijune sector/Legends|Nijune]], [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen]], and [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sectors]]. Following a major victory at the [[Battle of Vinsoth (Imperial Period)|battle]] of [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]], Romodi and Screed pursued the Separatists to [[Binquaros]]. There Romodi remained to lay [[Siege of Binquaros|siege]] to the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] leadership while Screed followed the enemy [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]]. While Screed was away, however, pirates driven from the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] by Imperial forces joined forces with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] from [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] and broke Romodi's siege, allowing the remaining Separatists to flee to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. After Screed returned from his [[Battle of Bimmiel|victory]] at Bimmiel, he and Romodi once more gave chase. Acting on intelligence from a [[Unidentified pirate captain (Vardoss)|pirate captain]], the Imperials finally caught and [[Assault on Vardoss IV|defeated]] the Separatists at [[Vardoss system/Legends|Vardoss]]. News of the victories at Vinsoth and Vardoss reached the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and Romodi was praised as an example of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order's]] success upon his return to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] at the conclusion of the campaign.<ref name="EGTW" />

For two years Romodi remained out of the field as the Empire grew and expanded. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] charged [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] with pacifying the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]], where the remnants of Confederate General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] forces were hiding out among the pirate and [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] groups. Tarkin requested considerable military resources, among them Romodi, who was appointed as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Army/Legends|army]] operations.<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[Western Reaches Operation]] saw the Empire gain full control of dozens of worlds across eight sectors<ref name="Insider132">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref> and received widespread media coverage throughout the Empire. [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] footage of Romodi in the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai|battle]] of [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]]<ref name="EGTW" />&mdash;where Separatist holdouts had taken shelter in the [[Citadel of Axes]], protected from the Imperial [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] by a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]]<ref name="Insider132" />&mdash;and the [[Battle of Ord Vaug|victory]] at [[Ord Vaug]] made him famous for his unique leadership style, directing his battles from the open hatch of a [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|Floating Fortress]] assault vehicle. After years of exposure to [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] shell explosions, Romodi had his [[Ear/Legends|eardrums]] replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implants]] to avoid the possibility of hearing loss.<ref name="EGTW" />

It was during the [[Ambush at Bryndar|operation]] at [[Bryndar]] that Romodi, fighting alongside Admiral [[Bannidge Holt]], was ambushed by [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]] in the guise of local officials. Holt was [[Death/Legends|killed]] and Romodi was badly wounded by shrapnel from a detonating [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenade]]. Left blind and with severe injuries to his face, [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and chest, Romodi was placed in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], but refused to leave the battlefield and continued to direct the last of the battle until the enemy had been routed with his subordinates describing events to him. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctors]] were able to save Romodi's life but he was left badly scarred,<ref name="EGTW" /> with wounds so deep that neither [[Reconstructive surgery/Legends|reconstructive surgery]]<ref name="ANHn" /> nor [[Nanotechnology/Legends|nano-surgery]] could return his face to its undamaged self. Cybernetic [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were installed to replace his ruined, natural ones, causing many in his company to be deeply unnerved by the unblinking nature of the implants.<ref name="EGTW" />

===Serving the Lambda sector===
[[File:ImperialsConferencing-ANH.png|thumb|right|250px|Romodi attends a meeting aboard the Death Star.]]
After suffering grievous injuries in the field, Romodi retired from active duty and instead became the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for the Lambda sector, working on Imperial Center as part of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. During his time in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], Romodi was a strong proponent for military spending and one of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine's fiercest advocates. Despite his strong will and vocal support for the Empire, Romodi's colleagues and [[Aide/Legends|aides]] soon came to realize that the decorated general had indeed suffered more than physical wounds during his service to the Empire. Plagued by horrific night terrors and complaining of having difficulty focusing on his senatorial duties, Romodi was forced to retire after serving only a single term.<ref name="EGTW" />

Following Romodi's withdrawal from the Senate, [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] Tarkin offered him a position as his [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]].<ref name="EGTW" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Empire completed work on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], a [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] armed with a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] capable of destroying a planet, which Tarkin intended to use to [[Tarkin Doctrine/Legends|instill fear]] in the population and end the growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. With the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] under Tarkin's command,<ref name="ANH" /> Romodi was appointed as the [[Space station/Legends|space station's]] [[Battle Station Operations/Legends|Battle Station Operations]] [[Chief/Legends|chief]], despite his state of declining lucidness.<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the Death Star became operational, Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spies]] [[Battle of Toprawa|stole]] the [[Death Star plans/Legends|battlestation's schematics]]. While attempting to retrieve them, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] oversaw the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a senator and member of the Rebel Alliance, who was taken aboard the Death Star for [[Torture/Legends|questioning]].<ref name="ANH" />

Romodi was one of several senior [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] present at a subsequent meeting in the Death Star's [[Death Star conference room/Legends|conference room]], during which Tarkin announced the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution of the Senate]] and Vader assured the assembled [[Officer/Legends|officers]] that the stolen plans would soon be back in Imperial hands. Despite Vader's assurances, some of Romodi's fellow officers, among them General [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]], were concerned that the Rebels may discover a weakness in the Death Star.<ref name="ANH" /> Romodi, however, was confident that Vader would successfully recover the missing plans and that the Rebels posed no threat to the Death Star. Romodi's faith ultimately proved misplaced;<ref name="ANHn" /> when the Death Star confronted Rebel forces over their [[Great Temple/Legends|main base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] led a successful [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|attack]] on the battlestation, resulting in its destruction and the loss of every life on board.<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Romodi was a capable military leader who distinguished himself in service to Lambda sector's Planetary Security Forces and the Galactic Republic before being appointed a general in the Imperial Army. Romodi's actions led to him being decorated and hailed as a hero in the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]; such was the level of Romodi's fame in the Core Worlds that many Imperial citizens could remember where they were when they learned that Romodi had been injured at Bryndar. The army and navy were not always known to cooperate smoothly, but Romodi developed a mutual respect with Admiral Terrinald Screed during the Ciutric Offensive. Romodi described Screed's forces as "guardians above the blue sky" while Screed came to trust Romodi's instinct for when a situation required the precision of Imperial Army forces. Romodi was fearless on the battlefield, known for leading his forces into battle from the open top hatch of his Floating Fortress. When warned that this would lead to loss of hearing, Romodi opted to have his eardrums replaced with cybernetics rather than change his command style. Even when gravely wounded on Bryndar, Romodi refused to leave the battlefield until the enemy were defeated.<ref name="EGTW" />

The injuries that Romodi suffered during the Western Reaches Operation left him with cybernetic eyes and scars that made him feared by many during his later career as an Imperial senator. However, Romodi had suffered more than physical injuries; he increasingly struggled to concentrate and suffered from recurring [[Dream/Legends|nightmares]], ultimately leading to his departure from the Senate. By the time he served aboard the Death Star under Grand Moff Tarkin, Romodi was only lucid intermittently, leading others to question why Tarkin tolerated his presence and the Grand Moff to remind them of Romodi's loyalty and sacrifices to the Empire.<ref name="EGTW" /> Romodi's belief in the Death Star's invulnerability put him at odds with some of his senior officers, among them General Cassio Tagge.<ref name="ANHn" /> Romodi had light skin and [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] which had heavily receded by<ref name="ANH" /> 0 BBY.<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Dangerous to your starfleet, General Tagge, but not to this battle station. I happen to think Lord Vader knows what he's doing. The rebellion will continue only as long as those cowards have a sanctuary, a place where their pilots can relax and their machines can be repaired.|Romodi's line in the ''Star Wars Episode IV'' novelization|<ref name="ANHn" />}}
Romodi first appeared in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[George Lucas]]'s [[1977]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Romodi's only appearance is in the scene set in the Death Star conference room, in which he delivers a single line during an argument with General Cassio Tagge.<ref name="ANHn" /> In the movie, Tagge is arguing with Admiral [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], who delivers a variation on Romodi's line.<ref name="ANH" /> In such situations, [[Lucasfilm]] consider the films to be the more [[canon]] source.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|holocron|33|What'd I say again? Select posts by me regarding continuity}}</ref>

Romodi was given a complete backstory in the [[2012]] release of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' revealed Romodi's first name of Hurst and detailed his military and senatorial career, culminating in his role aboard the Death Star.<ref name="EGTW" /> Jason Fry later stated on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] that Romodi is the "bald guy" during the Death Star conference room scene from the ''A New Hope'' film.<ref name="Fry">{{JCFCite|temp=yes|url=posts/88508|board=Expanded Universe|thread=BE EXCITED: The Essential Thread to The Essential Guide to Warfare|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2012-05-03}}</ref> This was confirmed in [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2013]] reference book ''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]'', which included a seating arrangement for the Death Star conference room.<ref name="DSOTM">''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''</ref> According to the fan website [http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman], Romodi was portrayed by [[Ian Selby]],<ref name="Aveleyman">{{WebCite|url=http://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=103470|text=Aveleyman - Ian Selby|work=[http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman.com]|archivedate=20140626061422}}</ref> an actor listed as one of the Imperial officers in [[Ann Skinner]]'s continuity notes for the scene.<ref name="ImperialGathering">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2016/10/behind-scenes-imperial-gathering.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=BEHIND THE SCENES: IMPERIAL GATHERING!}}</ref>
